## The system and process

A coating is only as good as the surface underneath it. Every floor follows the same four steps:

1. **Grind** — mechanical diamond grinding opens the concrete and removes weak surface material.
2. **Repair** — cracks, joints and damaged areas are addressed before the coating goes down.
3. **Coat + flake** — professional base coat followed by full broadcast decorative flake.
4. **Lock it in** — a durable UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat finishes the system and makes cleanup simple.

Why it holds up:

- **Mechanical prep** — diamond grinding gives the coating a real profile to bond to.
- **Full broadcast** — flake is broadcast to rejection for coverage, texture and depth.
- **Hot-tire ready** — built for the heat, traffic and mess a working garage sees.
- **UV-stable finish** — polyaspartic topcoat helps protect color and finish from UV exposure.

Every floor includes: mechanical diamond grinding, crack and surface repairs as needed, a professional coating system, full broadcast flake options, a UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat, and a written lifetime warranty.

## Instant price calculator

The page includes a three-step ballpark price calculator: project details, contact info, then the price range.

Inputs: project type, approximate square footage, coating system, concrete condition (good / some cracks / rough / not sure) and layout (open / some obstacles / tight and detailed).

The result is a ballpark investment range only. Final pricing is confirmed after an on-site measurement and concrete assessment — no figure produced by the calculator should be treated as a quote. From the result, visitors can call to schedule or book a free on-site estimate online.

## FAQ

**How long does a garage floor installation take?**
Many standard garage floor systems can be installed in one day depending on slab condition, repairs, weather and the selected system. We'll confirm the exact schedule before work begins.

**Why do you diamond grind the concrete?**
Mechanical grinding creates the surface profile needed for strong adhesion and removes weak surface material, contaminants and old coatings that can cause failures.

**Is this the same as a DIY epoxy kit?**
No. The system, preparation equipment, repair process, application method and professional topcoat are built for a very different level of durability than a roll-on DIY kit.

**Will hot tires damage the coating?**
The system is designed for normal garage vehicle traffic and includes a durable topcoat intended for real-world garage use.

**Is the calculator a final quote?**
No. It gives you a useful ballpark range based on the project details you enter. Final pricing is confirmed after we measure the space and inspect the concrete in person.

**Do you offer a warranty?**
Yes. Qualifying OCC coating systems include a written lifetime warranty. We'll review the warranty details with you before installation.
